verdict.rationale: Fellow's own MCP server lets users query their meetings in natural language from AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT without writing code (e.g. "What were my action items this week?"). The pricing page also lists an "Ask Fellow" feature. The documented examples are read-only questions, though, not commands that operate the product, and "Ask Fellow" appears only as a bare feature name. missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that perform actions (create/edit notes, complete action items), an in-product natural-language interface beyond the bare "Ask Fellow" mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items
